scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Disabled Students Pursuing (10th, 11th, 12th Equivalent Exams)
other_conditions: Applicants must have a disability of 40% or more
Applicants must be residents of Kerala State
Applicants must be students pursuing SSLC, 11th or 12th equivalent examinations
benefits_summary: Provides fee assistance for SSLC, 11th, and 12th equivalent courses, covering course fee, exam fee, registration fee, and admission fee as applicable.
